Xcode 27's SwiftPM clones swift-argument-parser (mlx-swift declares it for
its `encuda` tool target) but omits it from Package.resolved, because no
target we actually build links it. Xcode Cloud runs an older toolchain that
still expects the pin, and because Xcode Cloud disables automatic package
an out-of-date resolved file was detected ... Running resolver because the
Keeping the pin satisfies both: the newer resolver tolerates the extra entry,
the older one finds what it needs. `make package-resolve` re-adds any pin
listed here after resolving, and `make package-verify` fails when one is
missing so the drift is caught in review instead of in a release build.
